references.text: Achan's confession follows immediately after Joshua's call to give God glory and confess his sin
The Pharisees use the same expression 'give God glory' when confronting the man born blind, as a call to tell the truth
The Philistines are urged to give glory to the God of Israel, the same expression that Joshua uses toward Achan
Ezra calls the people to give glory to the Lord and confess their sins, using wording similar to what Joshua used
The prophet Jeremiah warns against hiding anything, the same warning that Joshua gives to Achan
Whoever hides their sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses them will receive mercy - the same principle underlying Joshua's call
The promise that God is faithful and just to forgive us our sins when we confess them reflects the principle of confession in the Joshua text
